`defuddle.js` is the unmodified browser bundle (`dist/index.js`) from
[Defuddle 0.19.6](https://github.com/kepano/defuddle), used by Obsidian Web
Clipper for article extraction. It is distributed under the MIT license in
`DEFUDDLE-LICENSE.txt`. The extension loads this local bundle only in the
current tab after the user opens the popup; no remote code is loaded.
